name: HarmonyOS Dev Runtime
description: DevEco, HVigor, HDC, Emulator, build, install, launch, screenshot, hierarchy, and diagnostics bridge for HarmonyOS Dev.

capabilities.title: HarmonyOS Dev Runtime
capabilities.description: Detect HarmonyOS project identity, resolve DevEco/HVigor/HDC/Emulator tooling, run build/install/launch loops, capture device facts, and report redacted diagnostics.

actions.name: detectProject
actions.description: Detect a HarmonyOS workspace and return bundle/module/ability/project identity without exposing signing secrets.

actions.name: detectToolchain
actions.description: Resolve DevEco SDK, JBR, HVigor, HDC, ohpm, and Emulator paths even when they are not on PATH.

actions.name: listEmulators
actions.description: List DevEco emulator instances and rank public API-compatible targets ahead of beta/non-public images.

actions.name: startEmulator
actions.description: Start a selected DevEco emulator instance and wait for an HDC target gate.

actions.name: stopEmulator
actions.description: Stop a selected DevEco emulator instance and refresh emulator and HDC target facts.

actions.name: runUnitTests
actions.description: Run the HarmonyOS module unit-test task through HVigor.

actions.name: assembleApp
actions.description: Build a HarmonyOS app artifact through HVigor assembleApp.

actions.name: buildProject
actions.description: Run the structured build pipeline and persist redacted build state.

actions.name: hotReload
actions.description: Attempt the experimental HVigor hot reload build and report fallback diagnostics without making hot reload the correctness path.

actions.name: installApp
actions.description: Install the latest app or HAP artifact to an online HDC target.

actions.name: launchAbility
actions.description: Launch the detected bundle and main ability on an online HDC target.

actions.name: captureScreen
actions.description: Capture a screenshot from a running emulator or HDC target when supported.

actions.name: readScreenshot
actions.description: Read a previously captured HarmonyOS Dev screenshot from the workspace runtime screenshot directory.

actions.name: dumpHierarchy
actions.description: Capture UI hierarchy JSON when the target-side probe is available.

actions.name: readLogs
actions.description: Read a short HDC hilog window and app runtime log paths.

actions.name: readDiagnostics
actions.description: Read redacted HarmonyOS project diagnostics, recent runtime state, and source control summary.

actions.name: getRuntimeState
actions.description: Read the persisted workspace-local HarmonyOS runtime state.

tools.name: HarmonyOSDevRuntime
tools.description: Detect HarmonyOS projects, operate the DevEco/HVigor/HDC/Emulator toolchain, and capture device facts for collaborative ArkTS/ArkUI development.
